title: High Beam Assistant and High-Related Mentions
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around high-beam assistant usability alongside unrelated mentions of high satisfaction, high mobility, and high pricing or tech content.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention strong overall satisfaction or mobility rather than clearly praising the high-beam feature itself.

negative.summary: The negative review describes difficulty noticing whether the high beams are on or off when using the assistant.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include questions or descriptive statements about automatic high-beam behavior and several unrelated uses of the word high, leaving sentiment unclear for the beam feature.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects linked by the word high, including beam assistant use, pricing, technology complaints, satisfaction, and mobility.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment about the high-beam assistant is limited.
Positive examples do not provide enough detail to confirm that praise is directed at the high-beam assistant rather than broader vehicle impressions.
